name: mind-elixir-mcp
description: Create, edit, and organize mind maps in the Mind Elixir Desktop app from any MCP client. Bridges stdio MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) to the desktop app's local MCP server.
long_description: Mind Elixir MCP lets any MCP client create and edit mind maps inside Mind Elixir Desktop. The bundle contains the stdio-to-HTTP bridge; the actual tools run inside the desktop app (must be installed and running, listening on http://127.0.0.1:6595/mcp). Available tools: new_mindmap, get_all_nodes, generate_mindmap, edit_topic, add_child, add_node_summary, add_arrow.

endpoint.title: Mind Elixir MCP URL
endpoint.description: URL of the MCP server inside Mind Elixir Desktop. The desktop app must be running. Default works for a standard local install.

tools.name: new_mindmap
tools.description: Create a new blank mind map and navigate the app to the editor.

tools.name: get_all_nodes
tools.description: Return the full node tree (topics, IDs, hierarchy) of the current mind map.

tools.name: generate_mindmap
tools.description: Replace the current mind map with one built from a JSON structure.

tools.name: edit_topic
tools.description: Change the topic text of an existing node, keeping its position and links.

tools.name: add_child
tools.description: Add a child node under an existing parent; returns the generated node ID.

tools.name: add_node_summary
tools.description: Attach a summary node that consolidates a range of sibling child nodes.

tools.name: add_arrow
tools.description: Draw a labelled connection arrow between two nodes to show a relationship.
